climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A Willamette Valley AVA in Yamhill County, defined only by elevation between 200 and 1,000 feet, where shallow, infertile, uplifted marine sedimentary loams and silt differ from surrounding soils.
